children: Craveworthy Brands, whose holdings include Gregorys Coffee, Wing It On! and Big Chicken, agreed to buy the parent company of Papa Gino's Pizzeria.

The acquisition of New England Authentic Eats LLC will add more than 160 restaurants and about $160 million in annual revenue to Craveworthy's platform, the company said. A press release didn't include the deal price.
Craveworthy currently has nearly 300 locations and over $300 million in systemwide sales. Its chief executive Gregg Majewski is a former CEO of Jimmy John's.
